classification_rule.CONTRADICTED: the review bytes affirm the carrier's false claim as true (carrier_text present in an affirmative frame, no determination marker in window)
classification_rule.MENTIONS_UNDISPOSED: a carrier mention exists but no window satisfies DISPOSES and the review does not affirm the claim (e.g. a gate-criterion pass over the field, or a bare quotation)
classification_rule.SILENT: zero carrier mentions in the review bytes
